newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia bourse expands, recalculates SBI index.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia bourse expands, recalculates SBI index.

text.p: The Ljubljana bourse said on Monday it had expanded and recalculated the blue-chip SBI share index to include warehouse company BTC.
The index now comprises 11 shares, effective today.
"We changed the index so that it would better reflect the market," said Darko Torkar, head of trading at the Ljubljana Stock Exchange.
The value of shares in the index will depend upon the capitalisation of each share, which until now had not been the case.
"The new calculation has been introduced in a way to ensure continuation of the index value," Torkar said.

Apart from BTC, shares of financial consultancies Finmedia, Dadas and Nika, banks Probanka and SKB, food producers Kolinska and Droga, health resort operator Terme Catez, drug company Lek and trader Kovinotehna are included in the index.
Shares included in the index represent some 80 percent of capitalisation of the main market of the Ljubljana bourse.
The bourse plans to revise the index in May and September.
Currently, there are 25 shares traded on the main market of the Ljubljana Stock Exchange.
